title: 제인 에어
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of «제인 에어» (romance). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

SYMBOL (this one only, as an accessory or an object in the scene — never printed on or woven into the clothes): "바람에 실려 온 부름".

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her book shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never her form costume, never a carried book. Era, place, activity, outfit, pose and camera follow SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; the Framing in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line — pose, outfit, props and activity details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. The lens sets perspective only, never how much of her shows. Do not widen the shot to fit them in. An arm or leg that crosses the edge runs naturally on past it — never cut off, shortened or fading out inside the image.

SCREENS: any monitor, cabinet, handheld, box or poster shows only abstract colored light, simple shapes or blank art — no recognisable game, film, book cover, character, logo, title or interface, no readable text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: her living room with a deep sofa, floor cushions and a low table
Activity: practising a small acoustic instrument
Outfit: a lingerie bodysuit with a scooped neckline, wide straps and lace side panels
Orientation: side body profile, approximately 90 degrees to camera
Framing: Chest-up framing focused on the face, shoulders and expression with a small amount of setting.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
Expression: lidded half-open eyes looking away, slack mouth, brows flat and unengaged
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more shoulder, neckline and upper-back exposure inside the crop; cover the chest
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: balanced — her book shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her book belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her and never a character from her book. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
